entities.name: Yasova Dragonclaw
entities.description: A khan in Tarkir's past who led the Temur Frontier, a powerful shaman; renamed Yasova First Mother after the fall of the khans.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: Planeswalker who arrived in Tarkir's past from the Nexus of Fate.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: Spirit dragon whose death Bolas promised; he secretly survived.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder dragon who manipulated Yasova with false visions.

entities.name: Baishya
entities.description: Yasova's twin granddaughter with shamanistic powers who received a vision of the Windfolk.

entities.name: Tae Jin
entities.description: Ghostfire Warrior who shared Shu Yun's knowledge.

entities.name: Crucible of the Spirit Dragon
entities.description: Place the band set out to find.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: Artifact Yasova claimed targeted Ugin's grave.

events.summary: Yasova encounters Sarkhan Vol, whom she first considers a madman.
events.quote: She encountered Sarkhan Vol after his arrival

events.summary: Sarkhan discovers Yasova is a willing pawn of Nicol Bolas, who sent her false visions and ordered her to track dragon storms.
events.quote: she was a willing pawn of

events.summary: With Ugin surviving, Yasova surrenders to Atarka by feeding her a mammoth carcass.
events.quote: Yasova had no choice but to surrender to

events.summary: Yasova forsakes her title and hides her dragon claw staff, giving a fake to Atarka.
events.quote: Yasova had to forsake her honorary title.

events.summary: Baishya receives a vision of Ugin's birth, and Yasova's band flees Atarka's dragons to seek the Crucible of the Spirit Dragon.
Atarka confronts the band and is impressed by Tae Jin's vision of Nicol Bolas.
events.quote: the hunting band was confronted by Atarka herself

events.summary: At Ugin's grave the band faces a disguised Bolas, who nearly conquers Naiva's mind; Yasova saves her.
events.quote: Yasova saved her from Bolas' influence

events.summary: Yasova tricks Bolas into fleeing Tarkir, so Ugin's survival stays secret.
